_comment: Curated subset of Project Euler problems where the obvious brute-force approach is computationally infeasible, so the task genuinely measures whether a model finds the right algorithm or mathematical identity rather than whether it can write a loop. These are the highest-signal problems in the category for evaluating an LLM. tools/build_task_registry.py marks matching tasks with hard_subset: true, and tools/score.py can filter on it.
_selection_criteria: Included when a direct simulation or exhaustive search over the stated domain would not finish within the 60s budget on a single core, and a specific insight (a closed form, a number-theoretic identity, dynamic programming, or a substantially better search) collapses it.

problems.title: Longest Collatz sequence
problems.insight: Memoise the chain; naive recomputation per start value is quadratic in total work.

problems.title: Maximum path sum I
problems.insight: Bottom-up DP. Included because it is the small twin of 67 and exposes whether the model generalises.

problems.title: Coin sums
problems.insight: Unbounded-knapsack DP; the naive nested enumeration explodes combinatorially.

problems.title: Prime pair sets
problems.insight: Requires pruned clique search over a concatenation-primality graph, not exhaustive 5-tuple enumeration.

problems.title: Cyclical figurate numbers
problems.insight: Constrained cyclic search with backtracking over polygonal sets.

problems.title: Cubic permutations
problems.insight: Canonical-form hashing by sorted digits; pairwise permutation testing is hopeless.

problems.title: Odd period square roots
problems.insight: Continued-fraction expansion algorithm; floating point cannot answer it.

problems.title: Diophantine equation
problems.insight: Pell equation via continued fractions. Brute force over x is astronomically infeasible - solutions exceed 10^30.

problems.title: Maximum path sum II
problems.insight: Explicitly designed so exhaustive path enumeration (2^99 routes) cannot work.

problems.title: Magic 5-gon ring
problems.insight: Constrained enumeration with symmetry reduction.

problems.title: Totient permutation
problems.insight: Restrict search to semiprimes near sqrt(10^7); full totient scan with permutation checks is far too slow.

problems.title: Counting fractions
problems.insight: Sum of Euler's totient via a linear sieve; enumerating fractions is O(n^2).

problems.title: Counting summations
problems.insight: Partition-count DP.

problems.title: Coin partitions
problems.insight: Needs the pentagonal number theorem recurrence; direct partition enumeration is impossible.

problems.title: Square root digital expansion
problems.insight: Arbitrary-precision integer square root to 100 digits; native floats silently produce wrong answers.

problems.title: Path sum: two ways
problems.insight: Grid DP.

problems.title: Path sum: three ways
problems.insight: Column-wise DP with an up/down relaxation pass.

problems.title: Path sum: four ways
problems.insight: Dijkstra over the grid; DP alone is insufficient once all four directions are allowed.

problems.title: Monopoly odds
problems.insight: Markov chain steady state, or a large simulation done carefully with exact rules.

problems.title: Counting rectangles
problems.insight: Closed form for rectangle counts; enumeration of grids is wasteful.

problems.title: Prime power triples
problems.insight: Sieve to the fourth-root bound and enumerate triples; naive iteration over the range is too slow.

problems.title: Product-sum numbers
problems.insight: Bounded recursive factorisation search with a tight upper bound.

problems.title: Square digit chains
problems.insight: Digit-sum state collapse plus multinomial counting; ten million direct chains is borderline and the intended solution is far better.

problems.title: Almost equilateral triangles
problems.insight: Pell-equation recurrence. The perimeter bound is 10^9, so enumeration is impossible.

problems.title: Amicable chains
problems.insight: Sieve of divisor sums plus chain memoisation.

problems.title: Su Doku
problems.insight: Constraint propagation plus backtracking; naive brute force on hard grids stalls.

problems.title: Anagramic squares
problems.insight: Digit-mapping search over anagram word pairs.

problems.title: Arranged probability
problems.insight: Pell equation recurrence; the bound of 10^12 discs rules out search entirely.

problems.title: Pandigital Fibonacci ends
problems.insight: Track leading digits by logarithm and trailing digits modulo 10^9; full big-integer Fibonacci is far too slow.

problems.title: Minimal network
problems.insight: Minimum spanning tree.

problems.title: Diophantine reciprocals I
problems.insight: Divisor-count identity on n^2; direct search over n is slow but survivable, which makes it a good discriminator.

problems.title: Diophantine reciprocals II
problems.insight: Same identity at a scale where search is categorically impossible - requires exponent-vector enumeration.

problems.title: Counting block combinations I
problems.insight: Linear recurrence DP.

problems.title: Counting block combinations II
problems.insight: Generalised recurrence with a search over the length.

problems.title: Red, green or blue tiles
problems.insight: Per-colour tiling recurrences.

problems.title: Efficient exponentiation
problems.insight: Addition-chain search with pruning; exhaustive chain enumeration blows up.

problems.title: Ordered radicals
problems.insight: Sieve radicals directly rather than factorising each integer.

problems.title: Palindromic sums
problems.insight: Enumerate consecutive-square runs, not palindromes.

problems.title: abc-hits
problems.insight: Radical sieve plus aggressive pruning. Notoriously punishing: the naive triple loop is O(n^2) over 120000.

problems.title: Repunit divisibility
problems.insight: Multiplicative order of 10 modulo n.

problems.title: Large repunit factors
problems.insight: Modular exponentiation against repunit divisibility; constructing the repunit is impossible.

problems.title: Same differences
problems.insight: Reformulate as a factorisation count and sieve it.

problems.title: Special isosceles triangles
problems.insight: Pell-like recurrence on the Fibonacci-related solution family.

problems.title: Pythagorean tiles
problems.insight: Primitive triple generation via Euclid's formula and scaling.

problems.title: Investigating progressive numbers
problems.insight: Parameterised construction over quotient/remainder relations; search over n to 10^12 is impossible.

problems.title: Perfect square collinear
problems.insight: Simultaneous square conditions solved by construction rather than search.

problems.title: Reversible numbers
problems.insight: Digit-pattern counting; direct iteration to 10^9 is on the wrong side of the budget.

problems.title: Investigating prime pattern
problems.insight: Residue-class filtering before primality testing; the naive scan to 150 million is far too slow.

problems.title: Searching for a maximum-sum subseq
problems.insight: Lagged-Fibonacci generator plus Kadane in four directions.

problems.title: Paper sheets of standard sizes
problems.insight: Exact rational expectation over a small recursive state space.

problems.title: Writing 1/2 as a sum of inverse squares
problems.insight: Meet-in-the-middle over prime-grouped residues. One of the hardest in the first 200.

problems.title: Counting capacitor circuits
problems.insight: Dynamic programming over sets of achievable rational capacitances.

problems.title: Factorial trailing digits
problems.insight: Modular arithmetic with factor-of-five extraction; computing 10^12! is absurd.

problems.title: Hexadecimal numbers
problems.insight: Inclusion-exclusion over digit constraints.

problems.title: Numbers for which no three consecutive digits have a sum greater than a given value
problems.insight: Digit DP.

problems.title: Exploring the number of different ways a number can be expressed as a sum of powers of 2
problems.insight: Recursive binary-representation DP on a 10^25 input.

problems.title: Finding numbers for which the sum of the squares of the digits is a square
problems.insight: Digit DP carrying both the square-sum state and the value modulo a power of ten.

problems.title: Using up to one million tiles how many different hollow square laminae can be formed
problems.insight: Closed-form counting over the lamina parameters.

problems.title: Consecutive positive divisors
problems.insight: Divisor-count sieve; per-number factorisation to 10^7 is too slow.

problems.title: Investigating in how many ways objects of two different colours can be grouped
problems.insight: Two-dimensional partition DP.

problems.title: RSA encryption
problems.insight: Number-theoretic characterisation of unconcealed messages via gcd conditions.

problems.title: Number Mind
problems.insight: Constraint satisfaction over a 16-digit space; exhaustive search of 10^16 is impossible.

problems.title: Semiprimes
problems.insight: Prime sieve with a counting argument, not per-number factorisation.

problems.title: The hyperexponentiation of a number
problems.insight: Tetration modulo 10^8 via Euler's theorem and the lifting-the-exponent structure.

problems.title: Prize strings
problems.insight: State-machine DP over attendance strings.

problems.title: Squarefree numbers
problems.insight: Mobius-function inclusion-exclusion up to 2^50.

problems.title: Investigating the behaviour of a recursively defined sequence
problems.insight: Detect the two-cycle the sequence falls into rather than iterating 10^12 times.

problems.title: Ambiguous numbers
problems.insight: Stern-Brocot / Farey mediant traversal.

problems.title: Prime-proof sqube
problems.insight: Bounded generation of squbes plus a prime-proof test; enumerating integers is hopeless.
